course.title: Science 11th (PCMB) - NIRBHAY
course.description:
The most powerful and fearless Crash Course & Revision Batch for Class 11 Final Exam 2026.

  1. Complete Coverage of All Subjects of Class 11 Science: Physics, Chemistry, Maths, Biology, English & Hindi.
  2. Live Interactive Classes (Minimum 2 Hours): Concepts + Numericals + Exam focussed questions explained clearly. 
  3. Recordings Available 24×7: Complete class recordings will be available on Next Toppers App/Website.
  4. School Timing Friendly Schedule: Classes will be planned according to your school hours. No clash with school studies.
  5. Two Live Classes Every Day: Each class = 2 hours. Final timings will be shared in the Orientation Session.
  6. Doubt solving class after every chapter completion. 
  7. Weekly Schedule Provided: A fixed weekly timetable will be given.
  8. PDF Notes After Every Class: Chapter-wise notes in PDF format. Available on the Next Toppers App/Website.
  9. Regular Tests for Practice: Chapter-wise tests, Full syllabus mock tests for Final Exam 2026.
  10. English, Hindi (Core) in Recorded Form — everything will be available till your last exam. 
  11. Batch Timeline: Classes start from 1st December 2025 and revision of syllabus completed by mid-January. 
  12. This batch is non-refundable and non-transferable.
